Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
Hi all.
I am hopin that anyone can shed a light on this topic.

Is or is not the First Tradition: the Masquerade cumulative?
Or..do you pay the pool to get the turn for each card in play, or is
once enough?

We had an argument on it and i heard some good ppos and cons, and I am
somewhat puzzled. i would say it is cumulative, but then with two
FT:tM's out you theoretically would be able to pay 2 pool and still not
get the turn you payed for..
Card text stated that when paying 2 pool you would get the turn.

Help me out here please, it cost me the table sweep tast night. (all 4
other players were down to 4 or less pool and I had 20+)

Tim

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tim Eijpe wrote:
> Is or is not the First Tradition: the Masquerade cumulative?
> Or..do you pay the pool to get the turn for each card in play, or is
> once enough?
>
> We had an argument on it and i heard some good ppos and cons, and I am
> somewhat puzzled. i would say it is cumulative, but then with two

Correct. It is cumulative. [RTR 22-DEC-1994]:

16) Is the First Tradition Cumulative? Yes, They would happen at the
Same time. So if you paid two blood you would still have to skip a
turn unless you paid another two.

> FT:tM's out you theoretically would be able to pay 2 pool and still not
> get the turn you payed for..
> Card text stated that when paying 2 pool you would get the turn.

The card text doesn't state that you get the turn by paying 2 pool.
Card text: "... must skip a turn or burn 2 pool ..."
